gsc.name: Data communications
gsc.reason: No business API or remote data exchange implemented.

gsc.name: Distributed processing
gsc.reason: All business processing is in one browser.

gsc.name: Performance
gsc.reason: Small in-memory dataset and a 4-second refresh; no measured SLA.

gsc.name: Heavily used configuration
gsc.reason: No dedicated constrained production environment evidenced.

gsc.name: End-user efficiency
gsc.reason: Search, filters, keyboard shortcuts and responsive layout.

gsc.name: Online update
gsc.reason: Working reservations, bay and alert mutations, limited to browser memory.

gsc.name: Complex processing
gsc.reason: Simple billing and aggregation; chart rendering is mainly presentation.

gsc.name: Reusability
gsc.reason: Shared table, modal, formatter and chart helpers.

gsc.name: Installation ease
gsc.reason: Static deployment without a build; no installation automation supplied.

gsc.name: Operational ease
gsc.reason: Automatic mock initialization; no production operations automation.

gsc.name: Multiple sites
gsc.reason: Four modeled facilities, not four evidenced independent deployments.

gsc.name: Facilitate change
gsc.reason: Modules and CSS tokens; business settings are mostly placeholders.
